description: Upgrade your kitchen with Innokit’s custom door panels, crafted from 304 food-grade stainless steel. Waterproof, termite-proof, and formaldehyde-free, they offer lasting durability and a sleek, modern look. With precise tenon-and-mortise joinery, our panels combine strength, style, and easy installation—perfect for a high-end, eco-friendly kitchen.
name: Custom Door Panels
